cohort: 237,293 Asian and Caucasian women who attended a prenatal screening and resulted in a singleton birth in an Ontario hospital between April 1st, 2015 and March 31st, 2017
finding: Asian women were at an increased risk of several adverse perinatal outcomes, including gestational diabetes mellitus, placental previa, preterm birth, low birth weight, and neonatal intensive care unit admission, but had lower risks of preeclampsia and macrosomia compared to Caucasian women.
mod_finding: Asian women were at an increased risk of emergency cesarean section, but there was no difference in the risk of elective cesarean section compared to Caucasian women.
